statement: At least one of the fixed7 degree-feasible Q-line mandatory10-pin candidates can be completed using at most2 currently degree-feasible anchors to yield a full42343-vertex graph of maximum degree12 and diameter at most5.
anchors: Every current full-base vertex of degree below12, excluding the candidate's10 mandatory pins. Existing extras are allowed. No third anchor.
exact_algorithm: Once per target in the union of the7 saved missing sets, reverse radius4 BFS in the unchanged base computes available-anchor coverers. Check all1-anchor intersections, then every allowed first anchor against the intersection of coverers of its uncovered targets for a distinct second anchor.
completeness: Current old-old distances remain at most5. A new point has distance at most5 to every old point iff its complete neighbor set R4-covers the old graph. Saved mandatory coverage already covers all other targets, so exact set cover of each saved missing set by at most2 allowed anchors is necessary and sufficient.
stop: First full candidate, complete fixed7 impossibility, or CPU limit UNKNOWN. No new centers/lines/seeds, no missing-count optimization.
